configurations.title: Profiles
configurations.subtitle: Only one is active at a time.
option.ctrl_tab: Ctrl + Tab switches windows (like Cmd + Tab on a Mac)
standard.info: The three keys before the space bar (Fn excluded) become, from left to right: Windows, Alt and Ctrl.
standard.not_recorded: No keys recorded: the keyboard stays as it is.
warning.altgr: AltGr will not work like this: to keep it, left Ctrl can only become Windows.
custom.hint: Pick the keys from the list, or use the keyboard button and press the key.
recording.title: Press the three keys before the space bar
recording.subtitle: In order 1, 2, 3, from left to right. The Fn key is excluded. Esc cancels.
recording.invalid: {key} is not valid: use the left Ctrl, Windows (Cmd) and Alt (Option) keys.
monitor.title: Pressed key
monitor.idle: Keys are read only while this window is in front.
monitor.altgr: AltGr works as on the original keyboard.
monitor.program: Key generated by a program, not by the keyboard.
status.foreign: PowerToys is using a mapping that is not in the list: activate one.
dialog.discard: There are unsaved changes. Discard them?
dialog.delete_active: This profile is active: activate another one first.
dialog.save_first: Save or discard the changes first.
error.empty_rows: Complete or delete the empty rows.
error.same_key: {key}: the original and the new key are the same.
error.duplicate_source: {key} is used twice as original key.
error.powertoys_missing:
PowerToys is not installed.
Install it with:
winget install --id Microsoft.PowerToys
and try again.
error.powertoys_settings: PowerToys did not create its settings. Open it once by hand and try again.
error.powertoys_close: Cannot close PowerToys. Close it from the icon near the clock (Exit) and try again.
error.engine_not_running: Mapping written, but Keyboard Manager is not running: check PowerToys.
error.pillow_missing:
The Pillow library is missing. Install it with:

python -m pip install pillow
